HyperServe __VERSION__ is a Go HTTP server library with in-process MCP,
WebSocket, SSE, typed input, and standard `net/http` handlers.

## What's new in __VERSION__

__HIGHLIGHTS__

## Install or upgrade

~~~sh
go get github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3@__VERSION__
go install github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/cmd/hyperserve-init@__VERSION__
~~~

Canonical imports:

~~~go
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/auth
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/jsonrpc
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/mcp
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/mcp/builtin
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/ratelimit
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/sse
github.com/osauer/hyperserve/v3/websocket
~~~

Only the latest stable release receives bug fixes and security updates.

See the [README](https://github.com/osauer/hyperserve#readme),
[v3 migration guide](https://github.com/osauer/hyperserve/blob/__VERSION__/docs/MIGRATING_V3.md),
[v2.0.x migration guide](https://github.com/osauer/hyperserve/blob/__VERSION__/docs/MIGRATING_V2_1.md),
[API stability policy](https://github.com/osauer/hyperserve/blob/main/docs/API_STABILITY.md),
and [production guide](https://github.com/osauer/hyperserve/blob/__VERSION__/docs/PRODUCTION.md).
